mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( users_id, integratedpayment_id, payment_used_point, payment_paid_amount, payment_impuid, payment_merchant_uid, payment_method, payment_pg_provider, payment_pg_tid, payment_receipt_url, payment_status, payment_status_detail, payment_amount, payment_cancel_amount, payment_buyer_name, payment_buyer_email, payment_buyer_tel, payment_fail_reason, payment_cancel_reason, payment_paid_at, payment_cancelled_at, payment_created_at, payment_updated_at ) VALUES ( #{usersId}, #{integratedpaymentId}, #{paymentUsedPoint}, #{paymentPaidAmount}, #{impUid}, #{merchantUid}, #{payMethod}, #{pgProvider}, #{pgTid}, #{receiptUrl}, #{status}, #{statusDetail}, #{amount}, #{cancelAmount}, #{buyerName}, #{buyerEmail}, #{buyerTel}, #{failReason}, #{cancelReason}, #{paidAt}, #{cancelledAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET payment_impuid = #{impUid}, payment_merchant_uid = #{merchantUid}, payment_method = #{payMethod}, payment_pg_provider = #{pgProvider}, payment_pg_tid = #{pgTid}, payment_receipt_url = #{receiptUrl}, payment_status = #{status}, payment_status_detail = #{statusDetail}, payment_amount = #{amount}, payment_cancel_amount = #{cancelAmount}, payment_buyer_name = #{buyerName}, payment_buyer_email = #{buyerEmail}, payment_buyer_tel = #{buyerTel}, payment_fail_reason = #{failReason}, payment_cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, payment_paid_at = #{paidAt}, payment_cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, payment_used_point = #{paymentUsedPoint}, payment_paid_amount = #{paymentPaidAmount}, payment_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
UPDATE payment SET payment_status = #{status}, payment_status_detail = #{statusDetail}, payment_paid_at = #{paidAt}, payment_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}

UPDATE payment SET payment_status = 'cancelled', payment_status_detail = #{cancelReason}, payment_cancel_amount = #{cancelAmount}, payment_cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, payment_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
SELECT * FROM payment WHERE payment_merchant_uid = #{merchantUid}
SELECT * FROM payment WHERE payment_impuid = #{impUid}
SELECT * FROM payment WHERE integratedpayment_id = #{integratedpaymentId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(payment_amount) as total_amount, AVG(payment_amount) as avg_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) as paid_count, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'paid' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END) as paid_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) as cancelled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'cancelled' THEN payment_cancel_amount ELSE 0 END) as cancelled_amount FROM payment WHERE payment_created_at >= #{startDate} AND payment_created_at <= #{endDate}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET payment_status = #{status}, payment_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE integratedpayment_id = #{integratedPaymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment WHERE users_id = #{userId} AND payment_status = 'pending' ORDER BY payment_created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET payment_status = #{status}, payment_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM payment p JOIN integrated_payment ip ON p.integratedpayment_id = ip.integratedpayment_id WHERE ip.integratedpayment_leader_id = #{userId} AND p.users_id = #{userId} AND p.payment_status = 'pending' ORDER BY p.payment_created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.*, ip.integratedpayment_amount as total_amount, ip.integratedpayment_people as participant_count, ip.integratedpayment_leader_id as leader_id, ip.integratedpayment_created_at as integrated_created_at, CASE WHEN ip.integratedpayment_created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_expired FROM payment p JOIN integrated_payment ip ON p.integratedpayment_id = ip.integratedpayment_id WHERE p.users_id = #{userId} AND p.payment_status = 'pending' ORDER BY p.payment_created_at DESC
